text: yarbo.com prices drift by page during a sale: the homepage bundle ladder (regular prices, 0% APR $774.92/mo) and the product page (sale $7,399, $616.58/mo) disagree on the same day — pin ONE vintage per article and never mix $774.92 with $7,399; note the sale exists in one sentence only.

The reviewer's rewrite re-introduces vocabulary from the brief, not just the draft: 'OEM' (used in brief/verified-brief prose) kept resurfacing in rewrites as an unglossed acronym and failed the accessibility gate 3 times. Strip maker/industry jargon from brief prose before review, or the rewrite echoes it.

First publish() can skip the illustration without any failure note in the tail; check the published artifact for image_path immediately. Recover: ensure_illustration(slug) → copy image frontmatter into the final draft → wp_draft.py --slug S --refresh-live (publish.py alone skips the live post without --refresh-live, which publish.py does not accept).
